namespace: flat initial-focus configuration for Control UI elements
effect: requests focus on the visible, focusable primary input when a control mounts, without opening a picker or reclaiming focus after data, validation, or option updates
precedence: same-key local Control option overrides flat form config, including explicit false; the generic $dynamic overlay is a future proposal outside current runtime conformance
consumer: packages/jsonforms-svelte-{flowbite,shadcn,skeleton}/src/lib/util/composition.svelte.ts and standard/extended Control renderers, including Monaco
